name: SANKALP: Hub for Empowerment of Women
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_group: Women seeking information and linkage to government schemes and services
eligibility: Women can use the information and facilitation services provided through the Hub and linked mechanisms.
benefits: Bridges information and knowledge gaps about schemes, facilities and services available to women.
documents: Usually basic beneficiary details; scheme-specific documents may be required for the linked service
application_process: Approach the Hub/related women empowerment mechanism for information and scheme linkage.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Government of India
